scientific_integrity: Exact normalized-contact equations are distinguished from unnormalized alternatives; all accepted stability conclusions follow from a rational full Jacobian and characteristic formula.
scientific_limitations: General infection-age result is an exponential-mode identity, not a global semigroup stability theorem; finite positive constant-rate counterexample does prove local asymptotic stability of that age-structured case by characteristics. Different variable conventions could define a different intended system. No empirical predictions.
title: A normalized-contact invasion-threshold reversal in an age-structured network SIR model
